changes: Interrupted preconnected captures retain the same timing label in partial results.
A connection before the prompt is observed and labelled rather than discarded or reconnected.
Initial, before-prompt and monotonic phase records are preserved.
A preparation error releases its own unused RAM lock so correction does not force another boot.
Logger cleanup attempts every owned child and output handle even when one fails.
Device removal during directory enumeration is retained as a read error instead of losing the run.
Console messages explain the outcome in plain language; machine-readable status fields remain.
The copied standalone guide resolves its documentation links to the public repository.

validation.scope: Boundary checks, full-flow fixture simulations, source-record freshness and a harmless real child process. No device/mount operation is run in these tests.

unchanged_limits: No raw CC/PD packet record or applied PS8830 state
No automatic authorization, role/mode change, raw register access, retimer scan, firmware update or reboot
Original stock ISO remains unchanged; overlay needs a verified writable FAT USB

vm_startup.environment: QEMU11.1.0, TCG,2GiB RAM,2 virtual CPUs,UEFI,private modified DVD copy

normal_console_trial.observed: Live environment booted, launched start-capture.sh/Python automatically and reached the unsupported-model guard.
normal_console_trial.collector_message: STOPPED: This collector is scoped to FA507XI or Latitude5540.
normal_console_trial.source_scope: First audited candidate before later reporting changes; evidence payload preserved privately.

vm_startup.other_trials: An invalid initial UEFI image, a shorter graphical observation and the first serial timeout are retained. They do not count as successful startup observations.
vm_startup.limit: Checks startup and scope rejection only. It does not validate a real USB writer, USB persistence, ASUS firmware behavior or a USB4 handshake.

serial_console_trial.collector_message: STOPPED: This collector supports FA507XI or Latitude 5540.
serial_console_trial.configuration: Same launcher redirected to ttyS0 for headless observation; test-only DVD and UEFI files.
serial_console_trial.limit: Later logger-cleanup, guide and formatting changes were tested offline, not re-booted. No USB persistence or USB4 operation was exercised.

documentation.scope: Short current pages replace stacked updates. Original dated pages remain at an immutable ancestor; original captures are not removed. Local links and filename case are checked.

cleanup.method: Windows Recycle Bin; receipt and tested payloads retained privately
cleanup.preserved: Stock signed ISO, delivery bundle, original dumps/captures/firmware, VM source archive, exact tested payloads, screenshots, logs and failed attempts.

failed_attempts: The initial GnuPG/VM setup errors, one fixture assertion, shorter VM observations and serial timeout remain private. They are not hardware-failure evidence.
